firstPlayerRule: The person who is hairy as a yak starts the first round.
clarifications: Put the Baby Yak in front of that player. They reveal their Action card first during Noon; play proceeds clockwise.
The Baby Yak passes clockwise at the end of each day.

internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2/printed page 3 gives the hair criterion and Baby Yak marker. Pages 3–4 explain the first action and clockwise handoff. Carriages, food and stone towers match inventory BGG 351038; the publisher identifies the game as Yak. SHA-256: 43e5dbb868865c4bd202aaa2a92e49d992f2f2072d972575bc50026c33782382. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The rules do not define how to judge yak-like hairiness or break a tie.
